backend/main.mo: Defines core backend actor with types for users, questions, tests, sessions, suggestions, and includes authorization and blob‑storage mixins with in‑memory maps for state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two admin‑related features to the frontend files and components they modify.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files covering styling, pages, hooks, components, and configuration.
frontend/docs/navbar-file-list.md: Documentation listing Header component usage, features, navigation items, and styling notes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including metadata, MathJax configuration, and root div for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router with view restoration, auth handling, role checks, profile setup gating, and SEO metadata updates.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: Error boundary component displaying fallback UI with options to navigate home or reload.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Stub component for exporting average results as PDF, currently logs a placeholder message.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays and manages comments for a question, allowing posting and admin deletion with loading states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, attribution, and disclaimer text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides the main navigation header with login/logout, identity handling, and responsive menu options.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Shows the overall leaderboard with rankings, highlighting the current user and handling loading states.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Renders MathJax-formatted content and re-typesets when content or theme changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Placeholder button for exporting detailed per-test results as a PDF.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Placeholder button for exporting score-only PDF results for a test.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Displays a profile setup dialog and saves user profile details via a form.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Placeholder dialog showing a question ID with planned full details to be implemented.
frontend/src/components/QuestionEditorDi: Provides a dialog for creating or editing questions with fields for metadata, options, images, and validation.
Displays a filterable, searchable list of questions with selection and delete capabilities, supporting admin actions.
frontend/src/components/QuestionManageme: Wraps subject selection, question gallery, and create/edit dialogs to manage questions by subject.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Placeholder button component for exporting a result list to PDF; currently logs instead of generating.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog for scheduling test start and end times, converting inputs to nanosecond timestamps and submitting updates.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Renders WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons that open platform share URLs with preset text.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Displays and moderates user suggestions with delete support, loading/error states, and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: Provides a feedback form allowing users to submit suggestions with validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/TestConfigList.t: Renders a grid of test configurations with status badges and actions to start or view tests.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Placeholder component displaying a stub for future user management functionality.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Shows a full‑screen loading overlay when a view is being activated based on context state.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: Gates access behind YouTube subscription verification and guides users through subscribing and confirming.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing view activation state with start, finish, and cancel logic plus a safety timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Hook that loads caller role from backend and local bootstrap, keeping roles synced and determining admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login, logout, and identity state via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks and converters for syncing frontend data models with backend types, handling profiles, tests, comments, and suggestions.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind CSS layers, theme variables, dark mode styles, and component-specific visual fixes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with project background, mission details, and styled informational sections.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Displays the admin interface with access control, loading state handling, and moderation/management panels.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Shows the user dashboard, fetching profile and test data, handling loading and error states, and displaying test configurations.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page showing hero content, branding, and login/start-test flow, triggering view activation on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Placeholder results page with basic layout and activation hook, showing future results display area.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Placeholder test interface page with header, footer, and a stub area for upcoming test functionality.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Local TypeScript interfaces mirroring backend types for user profiles, tests, questions, and related entities.
frontend/src/utils/externalBlob.ts: Utility for converting files to ExternalBlob, validating images, and retrieving display URLs.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Stub utilities for exporting questions to PDF with placeholders for future implementation.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: LocalStorage-based persistence of user roles per principal for faster admin UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Session-based storage and retrieval of the last viewed app screens, including validation and cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining color themes, container settings, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Tracks Day 3 tasks for implementing full Question Gallery CRUD, persistence, and image handling, along with existing features and pending requests.
